source_evidence: Exact player 'What is the conditions of this place that makes them ruins?' requests preliminary observable physical condition explanation. Cirren and the cooperating warders describe existing site geometry/condition, no new hazardous movement or full survey: old bridge collapsed, surviving rocky masonry abutment stands, 30x30 receiving hall with older sleeping platforms/ovens and later restraints intact but abandoned/needs cleaning, furnishings and structural inspection; 20x30 raised gallery dry with carved charter and mechanical controls; 30x20 lower chamber visibly ~2ft standing water, waterworks require safe attention; 60ft walkway/30ft stair usable on already traveled route, narrow exterior ledge has damaged section per bounded local guidance. Ferry and Hessa's occupied cottage are functioning and separate from unoccupied service-house claim. No measured overall structural integrity, restoration estimate, final acreage, bridge repair obligation, authorized spending, new salvage/evidence collection, paid inspection, automatic clearance or title. Cirren notes that recovery grant requires genuine hazards secured, resident rights preserved and adequate verification, not rebuilding full bridge. Both warders' provisional guardian agreements reduce immediate danger, do not establish safe/legal deployment or entire site clearance. V remains at gallery stairhead with party and warders, lower door open; no controls touched or archive visited. No new roll or game-time advance beyond ordinary immediate explanation.
